headline: Local Man Discovers His Refrigerator Has Been Writing Poetry About Leftovers
summary: The appliance's latest haiku about expired milk went viral.
fullBody: Gerald Thompson woke up to find his smart fridge had composed an entire collection of existential verse about his eating habits. 'The cheese drawer weeps for what could have been,' read one particularly moving piece. Literary critics are calling it 'the future of appliance literature.'
